summary: NIFTY 50 (NSE_INDEX) at Quote takes the index topic; its packet becomes an index Quote frame with the change worked out from the previous close.

notes: No live index packet was recorded; an index packet carries zero trades, book and totals.

deviations.reason: The web passes IIFL's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.

The web sends zero; the docs say leave it out (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, "Field availability": a field the stream does not carry is not invented as zero; lead decision 2026-11-09). An index has no trades or book: IIFL's index packet fills the last quantity, average price and book totals with zeros, which the web passes on; the desktop's index frame leaves them out, as the recorded Zerodha index frames do.

The desktop's index Quote frame carries price_change and price_change_percent, worked out from the previous close in IIFL's own index packet; the IIFL Capital web adapter sends no change at all, and price_change is not a docs key, so it goes (lead ruling 2026-11-09). Whether the docs' change and change_percent take its place for an index Quote (ruling 4(b): the docs define them for Quote and they come from the packet's close) is for Phase B to confirm with the lead.
